title: Shipwreck of Dellys
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Shipwreck of Dellys", at revision 1370738244, opens: "The Shipwreck of Dellys took place in May 1830, during the French conquest of Algeria. It involved French troupes coloniales, under captains Félix-Ariel d'Assigny (1794–1846) and Armand Joseph Bruat (1796–1855), who were captured by armed Bedouins of the town of Dellys." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q105821649, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1830 shipwreck". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
